title: SuperADD: Training-free Class-agnostic Anomaly Segmentation (CVPR 2026 VAND 4.0 Industrial Track)
mechanism: Training-free DINOv3 memory-bank AD built for train/deploy distribution shift: overlapping patches, intensity-augmented bank, coverage-aware subsampling, iterative morphological closing.
adaptation: E1 recall prior: bank = clean pool cells incl. half-cells; overlapping 224 crops of each 512 cell; intensity augmentation spanning the 5 sources' contrast; skip closing for crack maps (widens them), keep for inactive. Fuse as an extra input channel to PF or as a logit boost inside high-AD components.
evidence: R: MVTec AD 2 segmentation F1 62.61 / 57.42 / 54.35 on public / private / private-mixed test, above SuperAD and other SOTA.
min_experiment: Offline map on F51, H36, CV folds (<3 GPU-h); kill if <30% of PF-missed crack components >=20 px recovered at 1% flagged area. If it passes: PF + AD channel vs PF, 5 seeds, CV then E1; kill E1 crack relF1@2 gain < +0.03 or CV crack IoU drop > 0.01.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF section 5. D07 proposes a similar offline arm with AnomalyDINO / MuSc; run in the same table.
